verdict.rationale: The docs say OCR works 'even from low-quality or handwritten sources,' and the annotations feature extracts fields into a structured JSON format you define. Confidence scores are available at page, block, or word granularity. A community user independently reports digitizing handwritten forms with high accuracy, with a small share routed to human review. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of handwriting recognition (accuracy, limits), explicit evidence that confidence scores flag uncertain handwritten fields (e.g., thresholds or uncertainty markers), and coverage of handwritten marginal annotations as opposed to form fields.
